protocol.holdoutPolicy: No feature, pattern, prompt or extraction-rule modifications after seeing cohort results. Treat scored results as frozen V1 baseline; use a new unrelated validation cohort for subsequent changes.
protocol.trainingSeparation: Original InsideJob OS10 plus prior Scrappers sites.example.csv are regression/development only; cohort must share no exact host with either list.
protocol.roleHints: Sampling strata only, NOT reviewed labels and not expected manufacturing proof.
protocol.siteAccess: Exactly allowlisted hosts; respect robots, access denials and limits, no challenge bypass.
protocol.accuracyClaims: No product or manufacturing accuracy unless independent human-reviewed annotations are scored. Claim support, duplicates, record counts and crawl success are diagnostic only.
protocol.pages: Fixed max12 site pages, max 65 seconds per host; five fixed six-site batches.
protocol.humanReview: A separate evaluator reviews citations, business role and product identity without consulting the extractor predictions as ground truth.

limitations: Geographical coverage and language/platform mix are not yet statistically representative of all websites.
Domain and apparent role selection are candidates; ownership and individual pages must still be checked in source review.
No guarantee all 30 hosts permit crawling. Respect robots, 403/429, PDF byte/time limits.
Fisher Scientific and related distributors list other companies' goods; supplier listing is not proof of manufacturing.
